attributes.name: text-in-imagery treatment
attributes.definition: Whether marketing copy, labels or calls to action are baked into raster/graphic images rather than rendered as live HTML text.

values.definition: Copy, labels, badges or CTA text are embedded in image files.
All copy and labels are real HTML text, with images free of text.
Some text is in images and some is live, or the treatment is unclear.

attributes.name: image text content type
attributes.definition: The kind of text that is embedded in images when it is baked in.

values.definition: Button-like prompts such as 'SHOP NOW' baked into graphics.
Duplicated or ghosted category or section titles within graphics.
Captions, badges and general marketing copy within images.
